results.title: Marsden Rock
results.overview: Charlotte visits South Shields, her seaside hometown, with her teenage daughter Harriet. The trip leads the two into unforgiving realisation about each other, and how as you get older, things don't seem to change as much as you'd think.

results.title: stealing cars
results.overview: After his mother’s unexpected death, a teenage car thief, Matías, is sent to live with the abusive father that they ran away from thirteen years earlier.

results.title: The Mohican
results.overview: Joseph is one of the last coastal shepherds in Corsica. His land is coveted by the underworld for a real estate project but he chooses not to give in. When he leaves the man who came to intimidate him, the godfather’s own son, between life and death, he becomes the prey of a merciless hunt.

results.title: Dilshad Kederli: Wolf Tooth
results.overview: Provincial singer Dilshad Kadarli heads to the capital in pursuit of fame. Due to a misunderstanding, he is mistaken for a criminal and pursued. To make matters worse, Dilshad falls victim to the promises of fraudulent producers. Will his "Wolf's Tooth" talisman be able to save him?

results.title: Get Active
results.overview: A rap artist known as Hundred tries to leave his past behind him in favor of a more safe and comfortable lifestyle, but the violence of his old life follows him and his family.

results.title: Orlando Pantera
results.overview: Orlando Pantera (1967-2001) was a gifted Cape Verdean musician who died at 33 before releasing his solo album. This film revives his legacy through innovative sound and archival material from his daughter. It features contemporary interpretations by artists like Mayra Andrade and Princezito, highlighting his lasting influence on musicians today.

results.title: Reality Bites: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
results.original_title: Reality Bites: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
results.overview: Hannah's favorite reality show takes over The Cookie Jar. When the producer is found dead, Hannah and Norman team up to track down the killer. Chad invites Hannah to court.

results.title: Before the Sea Forgets
results.overview: On Da Nang's peninsula, where echoes of war linger, a gay tourist couple searches for a forgotten Vietnamese soldier's grave, shadowed by a mysterious skate crew carving their own paths.

results.title: Revolució 304
results.overview: Revolució 304, a TV3 documentary, uses Lamine Yamal as a starting point to explore racism, identity, and representation in Catalonia. Featuring voices from Rocafonda, it calls for structural change and a more inclusive future.

results.title: 伟大的胜利——苏联摄影师镜头里的中国抗战
results.original_title: 伟大的胜利——苏联摄影师镜头里的中国抗战

results.title: Policy
results.overview: Pali plans to kidnap his rude boss Hardev but backs out after Sonia’s heartfelt plea. Just when things settle a mysterious message shakes it all.

results.title: Q.I.A.
results.overview: Film students Queenie, Izzie, and Angie encounter a masked man named Masculado who threatens to distort every film there is  into his vision of queer cinema—one that only features masc-for-masc BLs. Using their powers, the trio must stop Masculado before he distorts cinema for good!

results.title: Inside Gaza
results.overview: Free access to the Gaza Strip has remained closed to international journalists since the war began on October 7, 2023. AFP's permanent reporters are among the few professional witnesses to have experienced this conflict from the inside. They have watched, filmed, photographed, testified, all whilst struggling to ensure their own survival.  From their exile, they recount this war, which is the deadliest ever recorded for members of the press.

results.title: Cottage Pie
results.overview: In this political satire, two teenage political activists knock on the door of a well-dressed cottage, unaware of the horrors and absurdities that await them inside.

results.title: Secundária
results.overview: Diana is an actress going through a long casting process for a film. Real life and her interactions with her friends make her question what legacy she is leaving in this world.

results.title: Our Day
results.overview: After a litany of bad relationships Rebekka has finally found the one, Osku. Though a little younger and cornier than her, he makes Rebekka happy. At the graduation party of Rebekka’s goddaughter, Rebekka runs to an old colleague of hers, and possibly, her future mother-in-law. Things are revealed about Osku that Rebekka hasn’t wanted to see.

results.title: Dissection of An Incoherence in Crisis
results.overview: Three girls in a trivial and absurd argument over how to make a paper airplane. Three adults in a sophisticated and intellectual debate about the details of a historical event. Two apparently distant problems but with a common core: the inability to manage envy and ego of the two central characters, Aran, the youngest daughter, and Artur, her father.

results.title: Desire
results.overview: In a bid to escape the grip of law and punishment, Shanu, a man with secret schemes, ensnares Amala - a woman grappling with psychological struggles. Together on a stolen bike, they embark on a journey where some desires are abandoned, while others reach completion.

results.title: All Hollow
results.overview: Halloween night takes a turn for the worse when a familiar masked intruder crashes the party.
